hookups.source: https://www.marblecampground.com/ ('Each campsite has a fire ring, picnic table, 15/20/30 electric and water') + ResNexus site list (every site 'Water, electric 30 amp'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: ResNexus lists 15 sites (numbered 1-14 and 16): four small back-in RV/tent sites (1-4) take 20 ft, the rest 30 ft; sites 5-10 are pull-throughs, 11-14 back-in tent/RV sites, 16 a premium site. 30 ft is the campground's maximum because the entrance and exits are tight.

Longer RVs have gotten stuck in the past') + ResNexus site list ('01) Small RV / Tent Site Back-in site ... 20' max', '05) RV Site, 30' Pull through site', 'Showing 15 results'), read 2026-10-26

facilities.source: https://www.marblecampground.com/ ('There is a shower house and dump station on-site'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Booked online on the campground's ResNexus page. Card payment only (no cash). Cancel 7+ days out for a full refund less a $25 service fee; 50% with 48 hours' notice.

booking.source: https://www.marblecampground.com/ ('Book a Campsite' -> ResNexus) + https://www.marblecampground.com/our-policies ('Maximum Stay cannot exceed 14 days'; 'We are unable to accept cash payment'; cancellation policy), read 2026-10-26

values.note: No nightly rate is posted. One vehicle included (an RV's towed vehicle counts as one); extra vehicles $10, and each OHV $15 a day.

fees.source: https://www.marblecampground.com/our-policies ('Additional vehicles fee is $10 per extra vehicle'; 'All OHVs are an additional $15 fee per OHV per day'), read 2026-10-26

note: Town-run campground in the heart of Marble (proceeds fund the community), among blocks of Yule marble, beside the old Catholic church foundation and across from Millsite Park, up from the Crystal River. An easy walk to the town's galleries, BBQ and coffee shop. Tight turns at the entrance and exits. --Claude
summary: Ownership confirmed local: the operator says 'we are a town run campground where proceeds go to fund and benefit our community' and the Town of Marble's 2026 budget carries 'Campground Revenue'. Confirmed 30 ft maximum, 30-A electric + water at every site, showers, dump, online booking (ResNexus). Added 15 sites incl. pull-throughs, 14-night maximum, extra-vehicle/OHV fees. No nightly rate posted anywhere (ResNexus shows every site 'OCCUPIED' off-season, no prices). Season unstated. Note: dropped field repeats.
flags: Name: the operator publishes 'Marble RV Park and Campground' (site title, ResNexus footer) and 'Marble Campground' (site header); 'Meri Daes' appears only in the Google Maps listing name. Suggest 'Marble Campground' or 'Marble RV Park and Campground'.
Waterfront re-audit lead: the stored value is riverfront, but the operator places the campground 'across the street from the historic Millsite Park and up from the Crystal River'.

No posted nightly rate (local campground, so no price gate): the website and policies give none, and ResNexus showed no prices for the off-season date read (all sites 'OCCUPIED'). RV Life tier $$$ (3).
Address: operator says 215 W. Park, Marble; ResNexus and Google say 220 W Park St. Phone 970-963-1714 matches.
